annotations.title: Get a Pokémon's usage over time

description: Show one Pokémon's monthly usage and rank in a regulation across a range of months, with its net change and peak. History exists only for months the regulation's ladder was active.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

from.description: First month, YYYY-MM. The nearest month with data is used if it has none

months.description: Months to look back from `to` when `from` is omitted. Defaults to 12

pokemon.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"

to.description: Last month, YYYY-MM. Defaults to the most recent month

name: get_usage_trend

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

netChangePoints.description: Last month's usage minus the first's, in percentage points

title: Get a Pokémon's usage over time
